details: index_transcript_page passed each TranscriptPage directly to update_session, which replaces the full session snapshot and short-circuits when snapshot_id/content_truncated match. A caller could index page 1, then page 2 with the same snapshot_id would be ignored, leaving incomplete searchable text and possibly incorrect coverage. The feed must require a locally assembled snapshot with next_cursor=None before any write while preserving native truncated as content_truncated.
